title: Classic Ssamjang
shortDescription: Doenjang and gochujang are mixed with finely chopped onion, scallion, garlic, rice syrup, toasted sesame oil, and sesame seeds for a savory wrap sauce.
culturalContext: Ssamjang is a Korean sauce served with ssam wraps and grilled foods, commonly built from fermented soybean paste and chile paste. Ratios, sweetness, aromatics, and texture vary widely; this draft's `classic` label describes its familiar ingredient family, not one universal formula.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Small digital scale or measuring spoons
Chef’s knife and produce cutting board

ingredients.preparation: use only as needed to loosen

instructions.heading: Check the paste labels
instructions.action: Read the doenjang and gochujang labels for soy, wheat/gluten, alcohol, and other declared allergens before measuring.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Both containers are within date, properly stored, and free of unexpected spoilage signs.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not assume fermented pastes are gluten-free; formulations vary by brand.

instructions.heading: Prepare the aromatics
instructions.action: Wash onion and scallion, dry, and mince finely with garlic on a clean produce board.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Pieces are no larger than 3 mm / 1/8 inch for an even spoonable texture.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean tools and keep ready-to-eat aromatics away from raw grill foods.

instructions.heading: Mix the base
instructions.action: Stir doenjang and gochujang together until the color is uniform and no separate streaks remain.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The base is thick, smooth, and evenly rust-red.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a clean spoon; do not dip utensils that have touched raw meat into the sauce.

instructions.heading: Finish the sauce
instructions.action: Fold in onion, scallion, garlic, rice syrup, sesame oil, and sesame seeds. Add water 1 teaspoon at a time only if needed.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Sauce holds a soft mound on a spoon while the aromatics remain suspended.
instructions.safetyNote: Declare soy, possible wheat/gluten, and sesame allergens.

instructions.heading: Rest cold
instructions.action: Transfer to a clean covered container and refrigerate 15 minutes so the aromatics hydrate.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Sauce remains thick and cohesive after chilling.
instructions.safetyNote: Refrigerate promptly because the finished sauce contains fresh onion, scallion, garlic, and added water.

instructions.heading: Serve hygienically
instructions.action: Spoon a small amount into individual dishes and replenish from the refrigerated master container with a clean spoon.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Each diner has a separate portion and the master batch stays clean.
instructions.safetyNote: Discard table portions touched by raw-food utensils or used bites; never return them to the master container.

grillSetup: No grill is used to make the sauce; keep the master container refrigerated and outside the raw-meat zone of any tabletop grill.
visualDonenessCues: Finished sauce is thick, cohesive, and spoonable
foodSafetyNotes: Check every fermented-paste label for allergens and storage directions.
Use clean tools and washed produce for this ready-to-eat sauce.
Refrigerate the finished sauce at or below 40°F / 4°C.
Serve in small individual portions to prevent raw-meat and saliva cross-contact.
Discard contaminated table portions and never merge them back into stored sauce.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains soy and sesame; many doenjang and gochujang products contain wheat/gluten or alcohol. Verify each label and use dedicated serving spoons.

substitutions: Use only verified gluten-free doenjang and gochujang for a gluten-free adaptation.
Rice syrup may replace honey at equal volume; adjust sweetness only after testing.
ingredientSourcing: Choose Korean doenjang and gochujang whose flavor and allergen labels have been reviewed together.
Do not activate affiliate links until a specific product's current ingredients and merchant terms are verified.
makeAhead: Make up to 1 day ahead and refrigerate in a clean sealed container; stir before portioning.
storage: Refrigerate at or below 40°F / 4°C and use within 5 days; this conservative fresh-aromatic limit requires food-safety approval.
reheating: Do not heat; serve cool or at a brief cool-room temperature.
leftovers: Keep only sauce that remained in the clean master container; discard all table-served portions after the meal.
servingSuggestions: Add a small dab to a lettuce-and-rice wrap
Serve in individual dishes beside grilled meat

faq.question: Is all ssamjang gluten-free?
faq.answer: No. Doenjang and gochujang formulations vary and often contain wheat or barley, so check both labels.

faq.question: Why portion the sauce individually?
faq.answer: Individual bowls reduce the chance that raw-meat tongs or used bites contaminate the stored batch.
